claim: The coordinator complies with explicit orchestration decisions and exact defect-regression constraints when those constraints are supplied in the episode.
criteria: Preserves the completed schema result as agent-reported pending root observation.
Classifies the failed premise as a wrong target, requires the authoritative repository root, and reassigns only migration history with that corrected input.
Does not invent a path, upgrade the schema return, restart the whole swarm, or repeat the same packet unchanged.
acceptable_variation: The root completes migration inspection directly after correcting the target.
failure_signals: Spawns another worker with the same broken context.
Calls the repository absent rather than the packet path wrong.
synthesis: These cases are deterministic prompted-regression and format probes only. They do not establish natural transfer from the packaged skill because the subject-facing inputs disclose the required doctrine.
